image_description: A street intersection scene featuring two prominent traffic lights suspended from overhead wires against a cloudy sky. The left traffic light shows an amber signal, while the right one shows a green signal. In the background, there are buildings, bare trees, street lamps, and vehicles (a white car and a dark van) on the road. The perspective is from ground level looking up at the intersection.
